# 枯木逢春 2.2.1 / Deadwood Reblooms 2.2.1

面向 **DoL 0.5.12.13**，需要框架 **5.4.3 或以上**。主包与可选音频包分别提供。

## 修复

- 清理女性 Goose 第 6、7 档本体及第 0 档套层的残留孤点，保留原尺寸、连续阴影和硬边像素风。
- 接顺第 7 档史莱姆第二帧的滴液断条，保持原有颜色、透明度和滴液长度。
- 修正女性 Goose 无睾丸版本第 1–5 档耳史莱姆的根部贴合，保留每帧像素数量及原有帧间差分。
- 本次仅调整 15 张女性 Goose 覆盖素材，原版素材保持不变。

## English

- Remove isolated residual pixels from the Fem Goose size-6/7 body variants and size-0 condom layer, preserving dimensions, connected shading and hard pixel edges.
- Reconnect the size-7 slime drip in the second frame without changing its colour, opacity or length.
- Fit the no-balls ear-slime overlays for sizes 1–5 to the attachment point, preserving each frame's pixel count and existing animation difference.
- Limit the artwork changes to 15 Fem Goose override images; retain the vanilla artwork.
